Round02Sparring & Training Rings

Four Rings.
Every Class, Every Day.

These are the rings the gym runs on — boxing classes, sparring nights, fighters in camp. A sponsorship here isn't a one-off; it's your brand in the room, every session, for six months straight.

Pick a single zone on a single ring, take a whole ring exclusively, or lock in multiple rings. Your logo stays exactly where you bought it for the full term — no rotating, no sharing the space.

Round04Where It's Seen

On The Equipment, Not The Wall

Ring sponsorship works because the ring is where the action is. People don't walk past it — they train in it, film in it, and watch it.

Daily
In the room

Classes, sparring nights and fight camps run on these rings all week. Your logo is in front of members every session.

Up Close
In the content

Sparring clips, class photos and fighter videos are shot ringside — your branding is in the frame, not the background.

Live
On the stream

On fight night the ring is the broadcast. Centre canvas, pads and ropes are on screen for every round.

Locked
For the full term

Your placement stays exactly where you bought it — six months on the training rings, the whole card on fight night.
